Integration friction (root causes observed):
- SDK gaps: Luminar runs large .NET microservices; our production SDKs are JS/Python first. Customer asked specifically for official .NET client with sync + async and connection pooling.
- Auth & Identity: They require SAML SSO + SCIM for user provisioning and managed KMS integration (HSM). Current roadmap shows SAML, but SCIM + KMS integrations are not yet enterprise GA.
- Observability & tracing: Luminar needs OpenTelemetry-compatible tracing hooks so tokens/requests can be correlated across their payment-authority services and our inference runtime. They want span-level cost/tokens metrics in their traces.
- Tracing context propagation: internal requirement to carry trace IDs through redirect/fallback flows to model variants — our current protocol doesn't surface trace headers end-to-end.
- Eval/Product gap: they requested model pinning + deterministic rerank configs for compliance; our routing fallback behavior needs clearer SLA guarantees for pinned variants.

- No active internal champion after Platform Eng left team for rotation -> follow-ups dropped.
- Budget freeze for new vendors until end of Q2.
- Competitor Anthropic offered enterprise SSO + on-prem container eval; Luminar engaged with them in parallel.

- SE to demo .NET alpha SDK and share timeline for GA.

2) SCIM for automated user provisioning (security wants offboarding guarantees).
